title: bee project plan
description: The project's plan as data: pieces of work, their status, dependencies and estimates. The docs site renders the Project section from it, and a bee board can be seeded from it: `items` is an object keyed by stable id (one object per item, replaced whole on write) and `order` is a list of ids (an Rga of ids on the board). Replacing an item whole means that on a board, a concurrent status move and summary edit on the same item keep only one of the two. Every value is plain JSON, so the YAML that holds it uses no anchors, tags or unquoted dates. A future export from a board must drop duplicate and missing ids from `order`, and must bump `schema_version` before adding any field, since an item allows no properties beyond those listed here.

as_of.description: When the file was last reconciled with GitHub, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

sources.description: Where the data comes from, in reading order.

columns.description: One column per status. On a board, these are a Board notion's columns.

owner.description: Who moves items out of this column, when that is one party.

order.description: Every item id exactly once, in display order. The docs build fails on a duplicate, a missing id or an id that is not an item.

id.description: Opaque, stable and never reused. Prefixes: task- (a plan task), bee- (a bee issue or PR), kuilt- (a kuilt issue or PR), out- (work outside the code). A slice keeps its draft id (kuilt-3126-d) once it is filed; its GitHub number lives only in `links`.

estimate.description: A range, always labelled as an estimate, with what it rests on. Wall-clock time from start to merge, not counting time waiting on Iain.

basis.description: Why this range: the merge history or plan text it comes from.

kind.description: task: a task in the v1 plan. pr: a pull request. issue: a bug or follow-up. decision: a question for Iain. kuilt: kuilt work bee depends on. outside: work outside the code.

summary.description: One sentence: what it is, or what it waits for.

parent.description: The item this one is part of. A parent depends on its children by definition, so a child never appears in its parent's `depends_on`; the docs build fails if it does.

depends_on.description: Items that must be done before this one can finish, other than its children. The docs build fails on a cycle.

started.description: When its PR opened, or when its issue was filed if there is no PR.

landed.description: When it merged or closed; for a decision, when it was ruled. Required when status is done, and allowed only then. Never before `started`.
